steps.prompt: $25 \times 37 \times 4$. Which order would you multiply in, and why?

cards.title: Look before you calculate
cards.body: Before you start, take two seconds to look. Is there a round number nearby ($\times 99$)? A pair that makes $100$ ($25 \times 4$)? Two numbers either side of a middle ($48 \times 52$)? A square ending in $5$? The right strategy turns a hard sum into an easy one.

steps.text: Going left to right, $25 \times 37 = 925$ first, is much harder.

cards.title: Strategy menu
cards.body: Near a round number: compensate. Times $9$, $99$, $999$: times the round number, take one lot away. Pairs: $2 \times 5$, $4 \times 25$, $8 \times 125$. Middle number: $m^2 - b^2$. Same tens, ones make $10$: $a(a + 1)$ then $b(10 - b)$.

prompts: Which strategy from the whole course do you use most often, and why?
